definitions: a short, explosive burst of breath or wind
a light pastry case, typically one made of puff pastry
an act of smoking a cigarette, pipe, or cigar
a small, soft pad or ball of material, used for applying powder or perfume
an exaggerated or effusive commendation, especially one appearing in a newspaper or on a broadcast
examples: He blew a puff of smoke.
He took a puff on his cigarette.
She applied powder with a puff.
The film received a glowing puff in the local paper.
